patterns.note: Asymmetrical project grid layout on the homepage, mixing full-width images with side-by-side pairs, creating a dynamic visual flow that prioritizes large-scale photography.
Consistent use of a single, clean sans-serif typeface across all headings, body text, and navigation, maintaining a minimalist and sophisticated aesthetic.
Predominantly neutral color palette with a very light off-white background and dark grey text, allowing the rich architectural photography to be the primary visual focus.
Project images and content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they scroll into the viewport, creating a gentle, engaging reveal effect.
The hero image features a subtle parallax scroll effect, where the background image moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, adding depth to the initial view.
The 'RECENT NEWS' section uses a horizontal scrollable card layout, allowing users to browse multiple news items without excessive vertical scrolling.

technique_notes: The site uses a scroll-triggered animation system (likely locomotive-scroll as hinted) to reveal content. Sections and individual project images are set to fade in and translate slightly upwards as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, staggered appearance. The hero image employs a fixed background or parallax effect where the image scrolls slower than the page content.
The primary navigation on interior pages transforms into a minimalist sticky header at the top of the viewport, ensuring consistent access to key sections while maximizing content display area.

design_tokens.type_scale: A clean, modern sans-serif hierarchy with moderately sized headings and body text, often using uppercase for labels and navigation, maintaining an understated and readable character.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all images, content blocks, and interactive elements, contributing to a precise and architectural feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing, particularly in the hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of openness and allowing the large-scale photography to breathe. Project grids are more dense but still maintain clear visual separation.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its elegant, image-first presentation of architectural work, using subtle scroll-triggered animations and a minimalist aesthetic to create an immersive, gallery-like experience. The emphasis on large, high-quality, often full-width project photography, combined with a clean, understated interface, makes the architecture itself the hero, conveying a sense of luxury and authority without overt flashiness.
